question: Should `peekaboo move --smooth` intentionally change from the existing linear 500 ms behavior to distance-aware human motion by default?
rationale: Both implementations are technically viable, but choosing the default determines upgrade behavior for existing automation and cannot be resolved from tests alone.

options.title: Adopt natural smooth default
options.body: Ship the new human-motion default, retain `--profile linear`, and treat the change as an intentional user-visible upgrade documented through the release process.

options.title: Preserve linear smooth default
options.body: Keep `--smooth` backward-compatible and require `--profile human` for natural paths, while retaining the generator and live-tail improvements.

recommendation.title: Adopt natural smooth default
recommendation.body: Ship the new human-motion default, retain `--profile linear`, and treat the change as an intentional user-visible upgrade documented through the release process.
